lines.text: Every day, thousands of traders walk into the markets… blind.
Too many numbers. Too much noise. Too many opinions.
It was time someone made sense of it all.
This is MACROARSENAL. Your terminal, built block by block. Your way.

lines.text: Forty markets, read every morning. A clear bias. And a reason behind every word.
When a number drops, you already know how the market reacted, every time before.
Hundreds of strategies, tested over twenty-five years. A handful survived. They're the only ones we bring you.
And before every trade, Doji checks everything. The calendar. The levels. Your risk.
Every evening, we publish our results. The wins… and the mistakes.
At night, crypto takes over. X-ray on the order book, live.
No promises. No miracle signals. Pro tools, in your hands.
